headline: Canon: Japanese and US humanoid robot vision modules to ship in second half of year | Industry & Economy
summary: Taiwan's Canon Enterprise reported first-half after-tax net profit of NT$511 million, up 151.7% year on year. It said vision modules for Japanese and US humanoid robots will ship in the second half.
why: Canon Enterprise is a Taiwan-based optical company supplying imaging components to electronics and robotics makers. Its results give a read on demand for optical modules in emerging robotics and drone applications.
